assessment: The study presents a valuable finding on the link between mitofusin function (MFN2) and Parkin-mediated mitophagy, and that the combination of mitophagy and mitochondrial fusion defects is the basis of cardiomyopathy. The data based on the in vivo models are compelling and provide clinically relevant associations. This finding is important for understanding mitochondrial defects as a basis of heart pathologies.
